one_liner: Mermaid CLI (mmdc) is a local open-source Node/Puppeteer renderer with no hosted API or credentials; the vendor's separate hosted Mermaid.ai API and official MCP server are a different product.
auth_notes: The CLI runs locally and needs no credentials. The hosted Mermaid.ai API uses Bearer API keys, and its MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 or a manually generated token, but that is a different product from the CLI.
access_notes: The CLI is free and open source and runs locally, with no hosted HTTP API. Separately, mermaid.ai offers a hosted render API that free accounts can use with a monthly credit allowance (open beta). A hosted toolkit should target that product.
blocker_notes: Mermaid CLI is a local binary that depends on Puppeteer and Chromium, so there is no remote API to authenticate against. The hosted Mermaid.ai API (free accounts work) and its official MCP server are a separate product that could be evaluated on its own and would likely be ready.

evidence.quote: The Mermaid MCP Server enables AI assistants to create, validate, and render Mermaid diagrams seamlessly
This server uses `@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli` internally, which relies on Puppeteer to render diagrams.
Any Mermaid account works, including a free one, and every account gets a monthly allowance of API credits. Paid plans include a bigger allowance.
